**Describe the Bug**

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open [free4talk.com](https://www.free4talk.com) room '...'
2. Open Free4Talk AI popup and select provider '...' (e.g. Groq, NVIDIA NIM, OpenRouter)
3. Set delay to '...' ms
4. Send or receive a message
5. Observe error

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

If applicable, add screenshots or paste non-sensitive browser console errors (Right Click > Inspect > Console). **Never paste API keys!**

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 128, Brave, Edge]
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS, Linux]

**Additional Context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
